snippet.title: Ayakashi Profile — Official Trailer | Free Steam Demo
snippet.description:
Four fighters, four buttons. Chain attacks, specials and spells into aerial follow-ups and ultimate attacks in Ayakashi Profile, a Japanese-fantasy turn-based combo RPG.

Play the free Steam demo and wishlist the full game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5261450/?l=english&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=igdb_20261104

The demo includes all four battles of the First Gate. The full game is scheduled for November 30, 2026.

Follow Kikyou, Tengu, Hannya and Yuki-onna through a story told in motion comics.

English trailer. Gameplay UI shown in Japanese. Art and localization use AI-assisted production.

Developer / Publisher: Hyakki Yagyo inc
Press materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CxNaoaOktJTYald3pe12Mf6RKsBMZkaG

#AyakashiProfile #IndieGame #JRPG
